parties: Ashiana Housing Limited; International Finance Corporation (IFC)
headline: Ashiana Housing repays ₹35 cr to IFC on listed NCDs
sum: Ashiana Housing Limited repaid ₹35 crore to the International Finance Corporation on 6 March 2026 as partial redemption and interest payment on Non-Convertible Debentures listed on BSE.
implication: The prepayment signals confidence in Ashiana's liquidity and refinancing capacity; partners should track NCD maturity profile and covenant compliance on remaining IFC facilities.
detail: The payment of INR 35,00,00,000 was made directly to IFC and comprised both principal redemption and accrued interest on NCDs. The debentures are listed on BSE Ltd., making this a regulated debt capital market transaction. The partial prepayment suggests Ashiana was managing cash generation and debt maturity laddering. No competing bids or M&A complexity; this is a straightforward debt servicing event by a real-estate developer.
